subject: Draft: joint evaluation roadmap + 50-day close skeleton

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Holly Park <holly@nebulaworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: joint evaluation roadmap + 50-day close skeleton

Holly —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our conversation, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template and a short slide skeleton that outlines a 50-day path to a pilot/POC acceptance milestone. This is intentionally lightweight so we can adapt around your procurement and security gating.

High level ask from our side: can you confirm the stakeholders we should include in the MAP (technical and procurement), and whether NeBulaWorks has any non-negotiable acceptance criteria (e.g., SLOs, data residency, encryption at rest)? Once we have that, we’ll update the GDoc and lock a kickoff slot.

Suggested next steps:
- You: confirm primary technical lead and procurement contact (name + email)
- Us: update MAP GDoc with stakeholder RACI + acceptance criteria
- Kickoff: 45-minute working session to align milestones and risks (I propose Tue/Wed next week)

I’ve attached: redwood_map_template_v1.gdoc and 50day-close-outline.pptx (slide skeleton). I’ll also add a HubSpot MAP record and share after this thread.

If helpful I can include our security lead on a 30-min follow-up to walk the vendor questionnaire.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Thanks Markus — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Two quick notes from our side:
1) Stakeholders:
   - Technical lead: Samir Gupta (samir.g@nebulaworks.com)
   - Procurement: Clara Reyes (clara@nebulaworks.com)

Can you add Samir and Clara to the MAP doc and flag the security checkpoint? Otherwise the 50-day plan looks like a good starting point.

I dropped a first edit into the GDoc (link below) — it includes:
- Stakeholder RACI (Samir = Tech Lead, Clara = Procurement)
- Week-by-week milestones for the 50-day path (Discovery, Pilot Setup, Pilot Run, Acceptance)
- Acceptance criteria stub (functionality + latency targets + data handling)
